user_confirmed.A3: Connection classifier inherited from A2 plus SE3 head supervised only by MMFF94s cross-fragment bond length
user_confirmed.A4: Same head plus bond-angle and relative bond-axis/nonrotatable double-bond torsion supervision; no target torsion loss for single bonds

frozen_modules: baseline checkpoint file and its frozen legacy expert

data.canonical_graph_split: Preserve original source train/dev/test; canonical isomeric molecule grouping; reserve scaffold test families before selecting all other sets
data.conformer_selection: Index0 plus deterministic hash-selected other 3, at most4; invalid conformers recorded without replacement; no energy/quality ranking
data.rigid_fragments: Actual per-conformer internal geometry in vocabulary-aligned local frames; all atoms in a fragment move rigidly; exact graph/atom/stereo verification
data.reference_bond: MMFF94s full original molecule equilibrium lengths; unavailable mask false and recorded, never fixed element-pair constants
data.reference_angle: Per-conformer original GEOM angle, radians in loss, degrees in metrics

noise.provider: Frozen official SE3Diffuser forward_marginal VP/IGSO3 parameters
noise.frames: T centroid in Angstrom; scaled C0=T0/2.7; Q0=R0; identity refR and zero offset for molecule-only frames
noise.paired_evaluation: Fixed hash(seed, conformer ID, t) for official marginal; common per-conformer noise independent of batch/subset/order, shared raw/search/geometry/MMFF

classification.conformer_schedule: All2000 mothers once per epoch; conformer epoch modulo available count; epoch40 rotates all retained conformers
classification.loss: sqrt inverse-frequency weighted CE, max weight30, equal-molecule weighting plus .2 stereoCE on true double bonds
classification.selection: Best mean raw typed-port F1 over all256 validation molecules, first available conformer, 3 noise levels; every5 epochs; no test selection
classification.raw_decoding: Argmax no-bond/single/double, no forced complete tree; binary AP also retained

geometry.architecture: Local 6D twist MLP; atomZ/point-cloud, identities, composition, relative poses, bond order/stereo, t; shared directed messages; global-translation removal
geometry.loss_A3: mean squared bond distance residual in A^2
geometry.selection: Best same objective on all256 validation molecules and 3 fixed noise strata every5 epochs

predicted_adaptation.wrong_edges: Remain in predicted graph input; no false edge gets true geometric target; only true matching typed/stereo edges and compatible angles supervised

joint.gate_B: Oracle bond MAE improves >=10%; A4 angle MAE also improves
joint.selection: Joint geometry+CE validation loss; CE gradient through corrected coordinates enabled; discrete search detached

search.source: Same hierarchical_search, all legal input-only port options, fixed SearchConfig

MMFF.starting_point: Original noisy coordinates, independent of neural correction
MMFF.topology: Oracle true full graph; explicitly diagnostic

metrics.severe_nonbond_clash: inter-fragment nonbonded pair outside 1-2/1-3 neighbors, distance < .6*(vdw radii sum)
metrics.baseline_pretraining_scope: Scaffold disjoint relative to this GEOM fine-tune/smoke, not proven unseen across the PDBBind pretraining universe
